name: itqan-mobile
description: إتقان (Itqan) — the Android & iOS app. It wraps the website in the parent folder with Capacitor; see MOBILE.md.

scripts.sync:android: node scripts/copy-web.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: node scripts/copy-web.js && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap open ios
